Autoplay RAF tick — advances once duration has elapsed. The elapsed calculation now - start + accumulated lets pause/resume continue a partially-spent dwell instead of restarting it. currentIndex + 1 landing past the last real slide routes through the clone — nav.ts's teleport then jumps back to index 0 invisibly.
